height_source: ARRChaser capsule 24 x 62 half height (Source/RogueRigs/Enemies/RRChaser.cpp InitCapsuleSize(24, 62)) = 124 cm; bp-chaser BodyMesh 124 uu centred on the capsule; model from the sole to the top of the cap
axes: forward +X, robot left +Y, up +Z; _L parts at +Y

decal.uv: UVMap (UV0) 0..1 on the logo quad only, other faces collapsed to (0,0)

warnings: eye_red is emissive in Blender (strength 4, #FF1010): the FBX does not carry emission, the Unreal material sets the glow

fidelity.method: Orthographic renders at the scale of the crops (same sole row, same px per cm), opened together with the matching crop (Read) in side-by-side composites compare_<view>.png; silhouettes: crop mask (yellow or dark pixels, closed) vs render mask (differs from the uniform background); the render is shifted horizontally by the best IoU shift (front +1 px, side 0, back +3 px) and the largest difference is the Chebyshev Hausdorff distance between the two filled silhouettes, in percent of the crop height.

silhouette_difference_pct_H.note: IoU is lowered by the crop mask holes (bright facets) and the curled hands; the Hausdorff maximum sits at the hands and at the foot toes.

C1.evidence: Block+cap z 0.655..1.0 H = 34.5 % H tall, 24 % H wide (29.8 cm), depth 34 % H at the hood apex (crop side measures 34 % at the apex, 28 % at z 0.70; the criterion text says about 29 %: judged against the crop), cap box on top (width 17 % H at its base), front leans like a hood (apex z 0.84, upper face leans back to the cap, lower face leans back to the bottom), block extends backwards. Side composite overlays within 2 % H.

C2.evidence: Dark recess 62 % of the block width (3.5 cm deep) in the lower half (z 0.69..0.78 H) with a red emissive octagon (6.4 cm across, centred); above it the logo decal (yellow plate, dark shield, yellow star glyph; 7.4 cm = 25 % of the block width) centred. The criterion says recess about 45 %: the crop measures 69 % (117 of 170 px) so 62 % follows the crop; if the owner wants the 45 % text, set RS in the script.

C3.evidence: Gunmetal pelvis 13.5 % H wide at the top narrowing to 8.5 % (narrower than the block, 24 %), 7.7 % H tall plus a yellow lower rim 3.2 % H (total 10.4 % H, crop 9.8 %), the rim visible in front view.

C4.evidence: Outer-to-outer arm span 68.3 % H (crop 69 %); upper arm 10 % H wide at the top, wider at the top than at the elbow, dark elbow connector, forearm 9 % H, dark hand with palm and three two-segment finger blocks curled forward and inward; elbow bend as drawn (shoulder x 0.196 to elbow 0.243 to wrist 0.293 H); hands end at 55.5 % H below the top (crop 55 %), slightly forward (X +4 to +9 cm) in the side view.

C5.evidence: Pelvis bottom to sole 55.8 % H (crop 56 %); thigh yellow box 8 to 9 % H wide in front view (crop measures 8 to 9 %; the criterion says about 12 %: judged against the crop), dark octagonal knee prism (r 4.2 cm, axis lateral) visible in side view, shin box 8.5 to 6.5 % H wide, dark leg bars visible between the yellow boxes in front view, legs straight and parallel, outer foot edges 41 % H apart (crop 43 %). The crop legs splay slightly outward; the model keeps them parallel as the criterion asks.

C6.evidence: Yellow foot (toe wedge, instep guard, heel) on a dark sole with two dark toe blocks (front slanted) and a dark heel block, 23 % H long (crop 23.5 %), 15 % H tall at the heel (crop about 17 %), pointing forward (+X).

C7.evidence: Yellow on block, cap, upper arms, forearms, hip guards, thighs, shins, instep and feet; gunmetal on pelvis, shoulder and elbow connectors, hands, upper leg bars, knee prisms, ankle, soles, toe and heel blocks; eye_red only on the eye octagon; logo_plate only on the decal; four slots yellow_body, gunmetal, eye_red, logo_plate on every part; no other colour in the renders.

C8.evidence: Exactly 10 objects named HeadTorso, Pelvis, UpperArm_L/R, ForearmHand_L/R, Thigh_L/R, ShinFoot_L/R; pivots at the joints (joints_cm in the report); hierarchy Pelvis > HeadTorso > UpperArm > ForearmHand and Pelvis > Thigh > ShinFoot; interpenetration between each parent and child measured with BVH ray parity: at most 0.87 cm (limit 1 cm).

C9.evidence: Large flat facets, flat shading, no panel lines, bolts or cables, no cylinder except the two knee prisms (ankle is a box, the crop shows an octagon there), total 1632 tris (ceiling 3000).

C10.evidence: Largest silhouette difference: front 3.37 % H, side 3.12 % H, back 3.63 % H (limit 5 %); top and sole rows coincide (0.3 % and 0 %). Row edge tables (outer arm edges, leg edges, foot edges, block edges) agree within about 2 % H except the shoulder connectors in front view (+2 to 4 % H in the crop).

still_differs: The crop has more and finer facets than the model (rounded hexagonal upper arms, thigh and shin guards, curled thumbs on the hands): the model is a coarser version of the same shapes.
The crop legs splay slightly outward (hip 0.09, knee 0.11, foot 0.15 of H from the centre line); the model legs are parallel (C5).
The foot is a simplified wedge: the crop has an octagonal ankle prism and slanted side plates; the ankle here is a box (C9: no cylinders except the knees).
Hip guards are plain boxes beside the pelvis; the crop shows rounded plates.
The back of the block is a plain slab; the crop back has several plates (small panel lines are forbidden by C9).
The glow and halo of the eye are not rendered in Blender (Unreal glow); the decal on the upper face shows a faint plate outline because plate and face share the same yellow.
Hands: palm plus three curled finger blocks, no thumb (the crop hand shows a thumb).

criteria_text_vs_crop.recess_width: criterion about 45 % of block width, crop measures 69 %, model 62 %
criteria_text_vs_crop.block_depth: criterion about 29 %, crop 34 % at the apex
criteria_text_vs_crop.thigh_width: criterion about 12 % H, crop 8 to 9 % H
